lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Joggle bend 1 (upper web to step), about 90 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% show a round outer arc with a concentric inner arc. Label is within 0.03 mm of the outer apex. It runs the full step width; the fold seen past the end is flange 8 thickness at the back corner.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Joggle bend 2 (step to lower web), about 90 deg with an Ri ~ t arc in all sections. Apex offset is 0.03 mm or less. It covers the whole fold, front to back.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Front flange 5 is bent up 9 mm along the full upper web. One line across the notch and holes is correct (same two plates). The station_median apex sits within 0.2 mm in all three sections despite the slight web bow. It covers about 210 of the 212 mm of fold.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Back flange 8 is bent down about 90 deg. Outer arc and concentric inner arc are confirmed at 25/50/75% and at t=80/88/92/94.5 mm, through the corner tab region. Apex offset is 0.36 mm at most. The line spans the full flange, 0 to 95 mm.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Vertical fold between the step and the 27 mm tab of back flange 8 beside the step. Sections at 1/4/23/26 mm and 25/50/75% show a round outer arc with a concentric inner arc: a real formed fold, not a butt seam. Apex offset is 0.04 mm at most. It covers the full step depth.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Small trapezoid back tab at the left end, bent down about 89 deg. A clean Ri ~ t arc is visible, and the 75% section also cuts the tab's hole collar. Apex offset is 0.1 mm at most. The line spans the tab base, about 26 mm.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Left end flange (with 2 extruded holes) bent down 20 mm, about 89 deg. The extent override matches the full flange base of 43 mm. Apex offset is 0.02 mm in all sections.

lines.label: B8
lines.reason: Step to its front side flange, 8 mm, about 90 deg. Clean arcs in all sections, apex offset 0.03 mm or less, full extent of 29 mm.

lines.label: B9
lines.reason: Lower web front flange bent down 9 mm, about 90 deg. Clean arcs, apex offset 0.02 mm or less, and the line spans the full 54 mm flange.

lines.label: B10
lines.reason: Lower web back flange (2 holes) bent down 9 mm, about 90 deg. Clean arcs, apex offset 0.02 mm or less, and the line spans the full 54 mm flange.
